blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
**носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Where does this path go to?
exercises.why: **ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Everyone has their cross to bear.
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
**ведёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Что за бред ты ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)?
exercises.why: **несёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: What kind of nonsense are you talking about?

exercises.q: Зачем ты ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) херню?
exercises.why: **несёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Что за вздор он ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)?
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: От тебя спиртом ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way).
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: От него ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) спиртным.
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: От Тома ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) спиртным.
exercises.why: **несло** — past tense (neuter) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) себя по-мужски.
exercises.why: **ведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Том ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) белую коробку.
exercises.why: **нёс** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Tom was carrying a white box.
